title: JSS Season 2 Skin Pack
description: The most Iconic skins of the second season of Jack's Silly Server.
body:
**For all JSS Season 2 enthusiasts**, get to cosplay the most _Iconic_ wearings of the server members! 83 different skins all related to the Second season of **Jack's Silly Server**.

**Made to work with both the Bedrock Skins and Legacy Skins mods on Java.**

_Made By TwentyFour711 and FigureTheCorpse._
